ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the recent charges and investigations.
questions: What is the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How are investigators working to prevent and detect fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread fraud and highlight the need for increased oversight. I will be researching and interviewing sources to get to the bottom of the story.
